segments.text: If you love the speed of C but hate the lack of features, you need to see this.
Meet Zen C, a library that finally gives C the batteries included experience. We all know C doesn't have built-in hashmaps, dynamic vectors, or safe strings, right? Zen C adds all of that.
It's a lightweight toolkit that handles networking and data structures with a clean, unified API. It basically lets you write code that feels as Python
